scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/engine packages/llm packages/agents packages/arbiter packages/forge packages/gateway packages/web packages/narrator packages/live packages/town && for p in agents arbiter forge narrator town; do tsc -p packages/$p/tsconfig.scripts.json || exit 1; done && tsc -p packages/live/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.lint: for p in packages/*; do node --max-old-space-size=6144 node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js $p || exit 1; done && node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js *.js *.ts
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm knip && pnpm test
